description:
Houston, we have a problem. Casablanca, we have a solution.

There are three of us. None of us has been to the Moon yet, but we’ve stared at it enough nights to have strong opinions about where to park. So for the Lunar Landing Site Navigator challenge, we’re building a map from NASA data that tells you where to land, when to land, and which craters to politely avoid. We have one weekend and a worrying amount of coffee. The Moon has no idea what’s coming.
